item.tib: yang zab gu ru'i thugs sgrub las don gyi lag len gdams pa drug po
item.coloph: zhes zab gter bstan pa'i mnga' bdag gar dbang 'gro 'dul gling pas zab gsang mkha' 'gro'i brda ris dngos su spyan drangs shing phyis me pho khyi yi lor dmar phyogs DAk+ki dgyes pa'i dus chen la ljon shing ge sar du mas mdzes mdangs ngoms shing*/ bya rigs sna tshogs kyi snyan glu lhang lhang sgrog pa'i sar dben pa'i yon tan thams cad tshangs pa'i skyid tshal du mkha' 'gro'i brda ris yi ge las zhal bshus te dag par phab nas ris bral phyogs med kyi rgyal bstan 'dzin pa g.yung drung bstan dbang gis yi ger bkod pa'o//
